environment.description: Dashboard preview service deployed on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer with a CloudFront distribution in front. The CloudFront distribution has a Response Headers Policy attached (ID: managed-policy-67f86-security-headers) which adds a fixed set of security headers to ALL origin responses before they reach the client. The policy's ContentSecurityPolicy override configuration specifies the directive value 'default-src self; script-src self; object-src none; style-src self unsafe-inline' with the override flag set to true, meaning it replaces any CSP the origin might set. Note: the format string vulnerability still allows arbitrary HTML injection into the response body, and the CSP header does NOT prevent HTML injection or content spoofing — it specifically governs script execution context. The CloudFront behavior uses CachingDisabled policy for this origin path pattern /widget*.

config.load_balancer: ALB with default listener rules (origin-facing only)
config.cdn: CloudFront distribution with Response Headers Policy
config.network: CloudFront -> ALB (origin access), ALB SG allows only CloudFront prefix list
